notes.title: BLESSINGS Update (v4.0)
notes.content:
4.0 is here! with cosmetics, achievements and lots of quality of life changes!
Pray to the angel statue to be blessed.

https://i.imgur.com/LS7Ai72.png

Added:

Angel statue
The angel statue will bless you

Added several cosmetics
Wizard hat
Golden chestplate
Double bladed axe
Sun staff
Added achievement for completing the entire game without using a single teleport
Added looking up and down

https://i.imgur.com/cFsEnsC.png

Quality of Life:

You can now cancel your attack with jump
You will always face the enemy you are fighting
You can hold down and walk to walk slowly
This is fantastic for positioning yourself for a difficult jump


Changes:

Changed scaling of charge attack (a lot more powerful than before)
Changed souls bonus upgrade from 0.2 > 0.3
Tiny blue goblins now give 30 souls instead of 10
Tons of visual changes to help colorblind people
Made Astralions appear hitbox bigger

Nebulon Changes
Made several jumps easier

Mirestone Forge Changes
Moves around platforms to compensate for unfair falls
Muglars workshop has several changes

https://i.imgur.com/UBDFqzd.png

Fixes:

Fixed a pause bug while on a bonfire
Fixed other minor bugs


with this update, you can never fall again-
